briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate multi-agent capabilities as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month with o4 leading in agentic workflows. Funding hit $11.9B amid heightened geopolitical scrutiny. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI o4 achieves 92% on agent benchmarks while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus counters with safety layers. DeepSeek R2 and xAI Grok-3 advance open-weight performance. Meta scales Llama 4 variants for enterprise.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities in multi-agent orchestration reported on arXiv. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production for 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace current safety frameworks by Q2 2027?
